g.text: UML sequence - Implemented saved opening and independent control review
Save profile, evidence and accepted exact terms
Accept original operation and schedule work
Current identity, sanctions and risk gates
Approve as a different canonical person
Resume original operation when current gates allow
Recheck current acceptance before positive opening
Stable party and restricted account business key
Validate concrete opening policy at activation
Bound current control / terms / generation evidence
Activate once; emit owned outbox fact
Existing or newly activated account ID
Reload or return after fresh issuer login
Lost Core acknowledgement retries the same opening identity.
Current terms and changed generation block stale activation.
